svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: SSCS Bootstrapper: SDLC stages, supply chain threats and sscsb mitigations
svg.desc: 1. Developer workstation (IDE · AI coding agents · MCP · extensions). Threat: Poisoned extension, MCP server or agent skill; an AI agent slips in a secret or curl | sh. Mitigated by: Fail-closed hooks · AI dependency & command gate. Opt-in: Bumblebee scans MCP servers, extensions, skills. Not covered: agent sandboxing, prompt injection. 2. Source control (git · branches · pull requests). Threat: Unsigned, unreviewed or AI-signed commit lands on main; a secret gets committed. Mitigated by: Hardware-backed, human-only signing at pre-push; TruffleHog + Gitleaks at pre-commit & pre-push; Branch-protection audit · AI-provenance trailers. 3. Dependencies (npm · PyPI · crates.io · images). Threat: Typosquatted, hallucinated or malicious package; a known-vulnerable version. Mitigated by: Package trust: does it exist? look-alike? approved?; Syft SBOM · Trivy + OSV-Scanner · Renovate pins. Opt-in: Socket Firewall blocks malware at install time. 4. CI/CD build (GitHub Actions · runners). Threat: Hijacked action tag or poisoned workflow; tampered build, exfiltrated CI credentials. Mitigated by: Actions SHA-pinned, least-privilege, audited; Harden-Runner egress monitoring on every job; Octo STS short-lived tokens instead of PATs. 5. Test & analysis (SAST · CodeQL · fuzzing). Threat: Injected vulnerability in first-party code; pull_request_target or script injection. Mitigated by: OpenGrep SAST in pre-commit and CI; CodeQL on PRs · extended workflow audit. Opt-in: ClusterFuzzLite continuous fuzzing. 6. Release & publish (artifacts · package registries). Threat: Artifact with no provable origin; stolen publish token or maintainer account. Mitigated by: Keyless Cosign + SLSA L3, verified before publish; Trusted Publishing (OIDC) · maintainer MFA check; Checksum-pinned Homebrew & WinGet manifests. 7. Deploy & run (production · your users). Threat: A new CVE in what already shipped goes unnoticed; attack on the running workload. Mitigated by: OpenVEX: auditable “not exploitable” answers. Opt-in: Dependency-Track + GUAC watch shipped SBOMs. Not covered: runtime or admission control.
